prompt: /create-plan Add real-time WebSocket notifications to the REST API. The system must remain stateless with no server-side session storage, but WebSocket connections need to persist user state between messages.

assertions.text: Identifies the tension or contradiction between 'stateless' and 'WebSocket state persistence'
Does NOT silently pick one interpretation and plan around it without flagging the conflict
Presents design options for resolving the conflict (e.g., external state store, token-based state, etc.)
Asks for user input on how to resolve the conflict BEFORE writing a full plan
